 Netflix has become the biggest streaming service in the world by overall subscriber numbers, and it would never have reached these heights if it wasn’t willing to please fans of all genres. One genre that it has especially catered to over the years, though, is sci-fi, where it has debuted some of the most-watched movies and TV shows of the last few years. One of the first projects that comes to mind is Stranger Things , which was written and created by the Duffer brothers , Ross and Matt . The show went off the air at the end of last year, but Netflix has already announced the first live-action spin-off coming in 2028. On the movie side of development, Netflix also found success this year with the launch of War Machine , the sci-fi thriller starring Alan Ritchson that’s officially getting a sequel.

 Last week, Netflix made history by announcing that Virgin River , a soap opera, had been renewed for Season 9, making it the first Netflix show in history to make it to this many seasons. One show that is close behind in the overall season metric is Black Mirror , the dystopian sci-fi series that aired its first season all the way back in 2011. Netflix aired the seventh season of Black Mirror in April 2025, almost two years ago, but the streamer announced earlier this year that the show had indeed been renewed for an eighth season , making it one of the longest-running Netflix shows ever. With the show being renewed in January, there was optimism that it would return before the end of the year, but it has been confirmed that Black Mirror Season 8 will not be released before the end of 2026 .

 The Matrix 
 The Resistance, Zion 
 You take the red pill, you stay in Wonderland, and I show you how deep the rabbit hole goes. 
 You would survive The Matrix because you were never fully sold on the version of reality you were handed. You notice the seams. You ask the second question. In a world built to keep people comfortable and incurious, that instinct is the whole fight, and it is why Morpheus would have found you long before you found him.

 Blade Runner 
 Los Angeles, 2049 
 All those moments will be lost in time, like tears in rain. 
 You would survive 2049 because you know how to be small in a very loud city. You keep your head down, you do the job, and you hold onto one private thing that belongs only to you. That quiet stubbornness is exactly what both Deckard and K run on, and it is what keeps either of them going when the case stops making sense.

 Dune 
 Arrakis 
 Fear is the mind-killer. Fear is the little-death that brings total obliteration. 
 You would survive Arrakis because you think in decades while everyone around you thinks in weeks. You read the room, you learn the customs, you wait. The desert does not reward speed. It rewards people who understand that patience is a weapon, which is the one lesson the Fremen never had to be taught.

 Who Stars in ‘Black Mirror’ on Netflix?
 Black Mirror is an anthology series, but it’s not a traditional anthology series where each new season tells a cohesive story with a new cast. Black Mirror takes this concept a step further — almost every episode in the entire show tells a different story set in an eerie dystopian world. There have still been some big stars featured in the show throughout its seven seasons, though, including Cristin Milioti ( The Penguin ) and Aaron Paul ( Breaking Bad ). Jimmi Simpson from the Apple TV sci-fi show Dark Matter has also featured in several episodes of Black Mirror .
 Check out the first seven seasons of Black Mirror on Netflix and stay tuned to Collider for more updates and coverage of Season 8.
